spec.description: Metrics overview for the Enterprise Homelab: monitoring health, compute, Proxmox, Linux VMs, Synology NAS, and Cisco switch.

spec.title: Target Availability
spec.description: Average share of successful scrapes across all targets for the selected time range.

spec.title: Load (1m, per core)
spec.description: 1-minute load divided by CPU cores. 100% means fully loaded.

spec.title: Filesystem Usage (fullest)
spec.description: Fullest real filesystem on each host.

spec.title: Network (physical NICs)
spec.description: Physical interfaces only, so bridge and VM tap traffic is not double counted.

spec.title: SNMP Jobs
spec.description: System/disk (synology), network (if_mib), and storage (hrStorage) scrape jobs.

spec.title: Pool Allocated
spec.description: Share of the storage pool allocated to volumes. This is not volume free space; see Volume Usage.

spec.title: Memory Used
spec.description: Physical memory used, excluding cache and buffers.

spec.expr: 100 * (sum by (instance) (hrStorageUsed{job="snmp-synology-storage", hrStorageDescr="Physical memory"}) - sum by (instance) (hrStorageUsed{job="snmp-synology-storage", hrStorageDescr=~"Cached memory|Memory buffers"})) / sum by (instance) (hrStorageSize{job="snmp-synology-storage", hrStorageDescr="Physical memory"})
diskStatus{job="snmp-synology"} * on (instance, diskID) group_left (diskModel) diskModel{job="snmp-synology"} * on (instance, diskID) group_left (diskType) diskType{job="snmp-synology"}

spec.title: Disk Errors
spec.description: Any non-zero bad sector count is worth investigating.

spec.title: Disk Throughput
spec.description: Read above zero, write below zero.

spec.title: Volume Throughput
spec.description: Per-volume I/O. Read above zero, write below zero.

spec.title: Network Throughput
spec.description: RX above zero, TX below zero. eth0 is the active interface.

spec.title: Throughput (RX / TX)
spec.description: RX above zero, TX below zero.

spec.title: Metrics Overview
